description:
Solve Kakuro puzzles! The addictive blend of Sudoku and crossword sums.
Master your mind with Kakuro, the ultimate fusion of classic crosswords and number logic puzzles! Often called Cross Sums, Kakuro delivers the satisfaction of a math brain teaser with the deep strategic flow of Sudoku.

Whether you are a newcomer learning the basic combinations or a veteran grid solver, Kakuro provides endless hours of clean, distraction-free brain training.
